name: Ai.Orchestrator.Plugins.Memories
description: A plugin for managing AI Agent memories

function.name: memory_health_check
function.description: Use this tool to check if the Chroma DB is available.

function.name: add_memory
function.description: Use this tool to save memories to later be used for the AI Agent in RAG

text.description: The text of the memory to save. This text should be intelligently formatted for maximizing vector database retrieval and storage.
The exact text to search for in the vector database. Supply text or query, not both. Text will take precidence over query.

query.description: A query string to use to query the vector database. Supply text or query, not both. Text will take precidence over query.

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Use this tool to delete a memory that is no longer necessary or out of date.

memoryId.description: The memory Id of the memory to delete. To get the memory record use find_memory tool

function.name: edit_memory
function.description: Use this tool to edit an existing memory.

memoryId.description: The memory Id of the memory to delete. To get the memory record use find_memory tool

text.description: The text of the memory to save. This text should be intelligently formatted for maximizing vector database retrieval and storage.

function.name: get_memory
function.description: Use this tool when you have a memory Id and you want to get the actual content of the memory saved in the database.

memoryId.description: The memory Id of the memory to get
